description: Elections Commission - L. J. S. Cabral of the Kalaniya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Freedom Party - K. M. M. Perera of the Bandaragama Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacating of offices and declarations related to local authority elections.
